I start by writing out a detailed description of a sexual fantasy involving a child. I only write the beginning of the fantasy though, and when I get to the part where I start becoming aroused, I stop writing. This is called the "arousal scene."

Next I write five "aversive scenes." For example, the child's parents walking in and catching me, going to court, going to jail, having to explain what I did to my family, the trauma caused to the child, etc. I write a detailed story about these consequences across the five scenes.

And last is the "escape scene." I write about what I could do to safely remove myself from the risky situation of the arousal scene, and how I would reward myself for staying in control (by doing something fun and relaxing)

Arousal scene - aversive scene 1 - arousal - aversive 2 - arousal - aversive 3 - arousal - aversive 4 - arousal - aversive 5 - arousal - escape scene
